summary: RFC-0049 OQ-9 (AISDLC-1444 OQ-B): when an auto-answer takes effect and how the operator sees it

options.description: Act at once as a reversible decision record; operator-digest delivered at the end of each 5h budget window once >=N auto-answers (N default 10, configurable), else daily, as an interactive artifact report linked through a configurable channel (default tmux pane or built-in notification); auto-answer drops to shadow if nothing delivered in 26h; orientation warns when delivered digests go unreviewed
Window/daily delivered plus a ping on low-confidence answers

body: Does an operator-question auto-answer act at once with a veto afterwards or wait a window, and how is it made visible? 30-day planner waits: median 2.1 min, p90 22.7 min, 16.8 h blocked in total; at the bar at most ~4 extra wrong answers a month.
